proposed_facts.reason: Canonical Sword IASA delegates to the shared checker. Shared entry initializes the latch; sampled absence of A clears it. Variant 3 is requested conditionally, and downstream selection returns swing_type + 341 only for Captain, otherwise reporting/asserting. The replacement correctly avoids continuous-holding and guaranteed-re-entry claims.

Canonical Harisen IASA delegates to the same checker. Its variant-3 request reaches motion selection before family entry, including the non-Captain assertion branch. The proposal and functionality document preserve this distinction.

Independently checked the complete animation callback and item transition definitions. Item presence and positive timer guard subtraction and restoration; no clamp exists. Selector mappings, forwarded speed, command consumption for unknown selectors, unchanged other commands, and the unconditional final shared animation call are accurately described.

Entry initializes the timer and damage callback. The callback conditionally applies attribute-dependent scale and reloads x5A0. The animation consumer is guarded by item presence and positive timer. Neither an enlargement guarantee nor a configured positive duration is established.
